raw.details:
YC Fall 2026 x Moss: The Zero Latency Builder Sprint

  • Build the next generation of AI applications with Moss and make latency your competitive advantage.
  • Powered by Moss (YC F25), this builder sprint challenges you to turn ideas from Y Combinator’s Fall 2026 Requests for Startups into production-ready AI applications where speed matters.
  • Moss delivers sub-10ms semantic search without a vector database, giving AI agents instant access to the context they need. Build AI experiences that feel truly real-time, whether they run in the browser, on the edge, on device, or in the cloud.
  • The challenge is simple: Build something where fast retrieval makes the product meaningfully better.

Why Build with Moss?

  • Under 10ms semantic search for real-time AI applications
  • No vector database required so you can reduce infrastructure and latency
  • Runs anywhere, including the browser, edge, device, or cloud
  • Built for AI agents that need fast and reliable context
  • Production-tested across more than 10 million real-time voice minutes

You will get access to Moss starter kits, technical resources, and AI-powered support so you can go from idea to working prototype quickly.

What Can You Build?

Real-Time Voice and Conversational AI:

  • Build voice agents that need to understand and respond instantly for field workers, healthcare, dispatch, customer support, and more.

  • Use Moss for: sub 10ms context retrieval, real time knowledge access, and low latency agent interactions.

Multiplayer AI and Collaborative Agents:

  • Build AI powered workspaces where humans and agents share context and collaborate on long running tasks.

  • Use Moss for: fast shared context, session history, semantic retrieval, and multi agent state.

Local First AI and The Small Cloud:

  • Build privacy first AI tools, browser copilots, developer utilities, or applications that run close to the user.

  • Use Moss for: local semantic search, on device retrieval, and lightweight AI experiences without heavy cloud infrastructure.

Agent Reliability, Security and Evaluation:

  • Build systems that make AI agents more trustworthy through runtime guardrails, evaluation, and context validation.

  • Use Moss for: fast retrieval, continuous context evaluation, latency tracing, and real time agent guardrails.

Build Fast. Get Feedback. Ship.

  • Start with Moss
  • Get a working Moss starter kit and begin building in minutes with support for LiveKit, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI.
  • Map Your Architecture
  • Submit your architecture early and get feedback on your retrieval pipeline, agent state, and potential bottlenecks.
  • Build Your Product
  • Use Moss to power your retrieval layer and focus on the experience, intelligence, and product you are actually building.
  • Ship It
  • Submit your GitHub repository, architecture diagram, and a two minute demo showing what you built.

Timeline:

  • August 24, 2026 – September 20, 2026: Registration
  • Read the complete hackathon details, understand the challenge and requirements, join the official WhatsApp community for updates.
  • September 6 – September 20, 2026: Kickoff, Build Phase & Project Submission
  • Build your AI application using Moss as the retrieval layer. Submit your Architecture Diagram, PRD, GitHub Repository, Deployed Link of the Agent, and Video Demo by 11:59 PM IST on September 20.
  • September 23, 2026: Finalists Announced
  • Submitted projects are evaluated based on Product & User Experience, Technical Execution, Speed & Latency, and Demo & Presentation. Top-performing projects will be announced as finalists.
  • September 26, 2026: Grand Finale
  • Finalists demo their products live before the judging panel at OJone, Bengaluru, followed by the final evaluation, winner announcement, and awards ceremony.

Prizes:

  • ₹50,000 in cash prizes across the Top 5 teams
  • ₹5,000 community pool for the Top 10 Social Media Builders
  • ₹3,000 pool for the Top 20 Referrers
  • Partner swag and cloud credits
  • Curated technical books
  • Digital certificates for qualifying submissions
  • Teams can compete individually or in pairs.

How We Will Judge:

  • 35% Product and User Experience
  • Does the product solve a real problem and is the experience compelling?
  • 30% Technical Execution
  • How well does the architecture and AI pipeline work?
  • 20% Speed and Latency
  • Did you use Moss effectively to build a fast and responsive experience?
  • 15% Demo and Presentation
  • Can you clearly show what you built and why it matters?

Meet Moss:

  • Moss is the retrieval layer for production AI systems.
  • When your AI application needs context instantly, Moss delivers semantic search in under 10ms without requiring a traditional vector database.
  • That means you can build AI systems that respond faster, run closer to users, and avoid unnecessary infrastructure. From real-time voice agents to local-first applications and autonomous AI systems.
  • Now it is your turn.
  • Take a YC-inspired startup idea. Build it with Moss. Push the limits of what is possible when AI retrieval is no longer the bottleneck.
  • Build fast. Retrieve instantly. Ship something real.
